_comment: REAPER's own track names, as it reports them over OSC.
The layout maps an A3 channel to a REAPER track number, and until
this there was nothing to hold that against: the note in the tests
said so -- "nothing here reads .RPP files", and a wrong-but-well-
formed number would be caught by a person hearing the wrong channel
move.
It turns out REAPER simply says. Point its OSC output at
tools/listen-to-reaper.py and it sends every track name. Recorded
here so a test can compare, the same way curves-golden.json lets the
parameter curves be compared.
Re-record when the REAPER project changes -- that is the point: a
track that moved in the project and not in the layout is exactly
what this catches.
Track 28 (Return) was added on 2026-09-29 from the shipped template
rather than re-recorded; test_layout_against_reaper now holds this
recording against that template, name for name.
